prompt: The video begins with a stationary view of a serene forested area at Castle Rock Beach, Meelup, Australia, under sunny daytime conditions. The perspective remains fixed, offering a clear view of the natural surroundings, including a partially visible wooden structure on the right side of the frame. The sunlight filters through the leaves, creating a play of light and shadow across the scene. The sky is a vibrant blue, peeking through the canopy above. The camera angle is slightly tilted downward, focusing on the ground covered with dry leaves and patches of dirt. The overall color palette consists of rich greens from the trees, earthy browns from the ground, and bright blues from the sky, contributing to the vivid and natural atmosphere of the outdoor setting. As the video progresses, there are no significant movements or changes in the scene, maintaining a consistent and peaceful visual experience throughout.
